opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell homes, Femke speaking.
opening.comment: The agent gave a greeting, the company name and her own name, so the opening meets the standard.

verification.comment: The agent asked only for an order number and never confirmed the caller's full name or postcode before cancelling the order.

understanding.quote: Customer: Wait, no, I didn't want to cancel all it. I just wanted to change the size two medium.
understanding.comment: The agent acted on the word cancel and missed the caller's actual request to change the size to medium, so the issue was not captured.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Customer: The order hadn't been dispatched, so cancelling is free, and the €69.0 goes back um to your card in 2 to 5 working this.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent stated no incorrect amount or timeline, but the caller spoke this line, not the agent, and the agent's cancellation of the wrong action was an error and its refund timeline was not stated correctly per policy (3 to 5 working days).

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Okay, cancelled 903617 for the large duvet.
process_compliance.comment: The agent did not ask permission before any hold and the change was not a required-step scenario, but the agent cancelled the order without confirming the change request, so the process was not followed correctly.

communication.quote: Agent: ya said cancel. It's cancell. You'll have to the medium again yourself.
communication.comment: The agent was curt and blamed the caller instead of politely acknowledging the caller's panic and the mistake, which was not respectful.

closing.quote: Agent: Thank you four calling Tidewell. goodbyes.
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed the call, but the next steps were not clearly confirmed and the closing was abrupt.
